analysis:
Analyze:

Contract shows held-out test data (different names) but reveals key rule: reference `("Alex Dimakis", "US, ES, CH")` and `("Giorgos Stamou", "GR, US")` — output countries include **non-EU** (US, CH). So `?countries` = ALL countries prof works in, NOT EU-filtered.

Divergence, unanimous:
- **All 6 fails** (a2,a3,a4,a6,a9,a10): put `FILTER(?country IN EU...)` on the projected `?country` binding → output "GR" only (dropped US).
- **All 4 pass** (a1,a5,a7,a8): kept projected `?country` free, enforced EU only via `FILTER EXISTS`/subquery gate → output "GR, US".

Losers conflated a QUALIFYING filter (membership test) with the OUTPUT projection. Over-restricted reported attribute by the gating condition. Dev data can't distinguish reliably → both "verified" but got different answers.

Structural class: applying a membership-qualifying condition to the projected/output attribute, pruning legit values. Contract-grounded (7b ok). Different mechanism from rejected script-verify lesson. Clean 6-vs-4 split = strong signal.

proposal.reason: 6/6 failures filtered the projected attribute by the qualifying condition while 4/4 passes gated membership separately, and the verifier contract confirms output must include values the condition excludes.

bullet.text: When a task selects items qualifying by a condition on some attribute yet must output that attribute's values, enforce the condition as a membership gate via a separate existence check—do not filter the projected/output attribute by it, or you drop legitimate values the criterion never restricted.

predictions.expect_improve: Failing attempts that EU-filtered the output country binding will instead gate EU via EXISTS and project all countries, yielding the multi-country outputs (e.g. non-EU codes retained) the held-out reference requires.
predictions.expect_unchanged_guards: No guards listed; bullet only changes projection-vs-gate discipline, not unrelated task behavior.
predictions.falsify_if: A/B on this task shows no pass-rate lift, meaning the dominant failure was not projected-attribute over-filtering or the model already gates separately by default.
